--- title: Line Height description: Set block line height. docs: - route: /docs/examples/line-height title: Line Height Demo - route: /docs/components/line-height-toolbar-button title: Line Height Toolbar Button --- `LineHeightPlugin` stores line height on blocks as a positive number in a `lineHeight` property. A block without one follows the theme's line height. ## Features - Block-level `lineHeight` storage as a positive number. - HTML `line-height` parsing into a line-height multiplier. - Configurable target block types. - Bound `editor.update.lineHeight.set` and `editor.update.lineHeight.clear` methods. - Registry dropdown toolbar with line-height presets and a Default item. ## Kit usage ### Add the kit Use `LineHeightKit` for live and static Plate UI setups. The server-safe kit targets paragraphs and all heading levels. ```tsx import { createEditor } from "platejs/react"; import { LineHeightKit } from "@/components/editor/line-height"; export const editor = createEditor({ plugins: [...LineHeightKit], }); ``` ### Add the toolbar control Install `LineHeightToolbarButton` separately when the editor needs a line-height control. ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @plate/line-height-toolbar-button ``` The dropdown lists the presets `1`, `1.2`, `1.5`, `2`, and `3` from its own file, plus a Default item that clears the value. Blocks with no line height check Default, and a selection with mixed values checks nothing. ```tsx import { LineHeightToolbarButton } from "@/components/editor/line-height-toolbar-button"; export function LineHeightControls() { return ; } ``` ## Manual usage ### Install package ```bash npm install platejs @tanstack/react-virtual ``` ### Add the plugin Configure the blocks that can store line height. ```tsx import { BaseLineHeightPlugin, PLUGINS } from "platejs"; import { createEditor } from "platejs/react"; export const editor = createEditor({ plugins: [ BaseLineHeightPlugin.configure({ targetPlugins: [ PLUGINS.heading, PLUGINS.paragraph, ], }), ], }); ``` ### Set line height Use the bound update methods. `clear` removes the property, so the block follows the theme. ```tsx editor.update.lineHeight.set(2); editor.update.lineHeight.clear({ at: [] }); ``` ## Ownership | Surface | Owner | What It Does | | -------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `BaseLineHeightPlugin` | `platejs` | Headless plugin that stores `lineHeight`, injects block props, and parses HTML line-height styles. | | `LineHeightPlugin` | `platejs/react` | React wrapper around `BaseLineHeightPlugin`. | | `editor.update.lineHeight.set` | `platejs` | Bound update method that saves a line height. | | `editor.update.lineHeight.clear` | `platejs` | Bound update method that removes a line height. | | `LineHeightKit` | Registry kit | Server-safe setup shared by live and static kits. | | `LineHeightToolbarButton` | Registry UI | Dropdown that writes presets through `lineHeight.set` and Default through `lineHeight.clear`. | The package owns line-height storage and parsing. The registry owns the dropdown UI and its presets. ## Behavior | Behavior | Source | | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | | Plugin name | `PLUGINS.lineHeight` | | Stored property | `lineHeight` | | Stored value | A positive finite number. | | Default target plugins | `[BaseParagraphPlugin]` | | Registry target plugins | `[PLUGINS.heading, PLUGINS.paragraph]` | | Rendering | Every stored value renders as CSS `line-height`. | | HTML parser | Parses `element.style.lineHeight`, as [HTML](#html) shows. | | Setting a value | Sets `{ lineHeight: value }` on matching blocks. | | Clearing | Unsets `lineHeight` on matching blocks. | | Non-target blocks | Are ignored by `lineHeight.set` and `lineHeight.clear`. | ## HTML `targetPlugins` is the schema placement truth. The plugin derives its render and HTML-parser injection targets from the same list. When pasted HTML contains an inline `line-height` style on a target block, Plate parses it into a multiplier and stores that number on the block. ```html

Readable spacing

``` | Pasted CSS line height | Saved value | Diagnostic | | --- | --- | --- | | `1.5`, `150%`, `1.5em` | `1.5` | none | | `107%` from Word | `1.07` | none | | `normal`, another keyword, `calc()` or `var()` | nothing, so the block follows the theme | a dropped-property warning | | `24px`, `18pt`, `1.5rem` | nothing, so the block follows the theme | a dropped-property warning | | zero | nothing | a dropped-property warning | | a negative number or other invalid CSS | nothing | none in a browser, a dropped-property warning on the server | A browser drops a negative number or other invalid CSS before Plate reads the style, so that paste saves nothing and warns about nothing. `platejs/html/server` keeps those declarations, so a server parse warns about them too. The warning arrives with the paste's other [HTML diagnostics](/docs/plate/html#results-and-diagnostics). ## API Reference | API | Package | Use | | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | | `LineHeightPlugin` | `platejs/react` | React line-height plugin. | | `BaseLineHeightPlugin` | `platejs` | Headless line-height plugin. | | `editor.update.lineHeight.set(value, options?)` | `platejs` | Sets line height on matching blocks. | | `editor.update.lineHeight.clear(options?)` | `platejs` | Removes line height from matching blocks. | | `tx.lineHeight.set(value, options?)` | `platejs` | Transaction form for a larger atomic update. | | `tx.lineHeight.clear(options?)` | `platejs` | Transaction form of `clear`. | ## Options | Option | Surface | Use | | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `targetPlugins` | `BaseLineHeightPlugin` | Element plugin descriptors or dynamic names whose nodes can keep `lineHeight`; injection is derived from this list. | | `options` | `editor.update.lineHeight.set`, `editor.update.lineHeight.clear` | Plate node update options for the target range and matcher. |
